title: NewsStoryPublishResult
description: news.story-publish-result@1: answers of news.story.publish on OpenVibe.News. POST /api/v1/stories/:id/publish → { changed, resolved_flags, story } (changed false when that revision was already published and no note was given; resolved_flags are the upstream flags the revision answers). POST /api/v1/stories/:id/unpublish → { changed, story } (changed false when nothing was published). Emits news.story.published|updated|unpublished and the Search index events.
